status: Closed — diagnostic consumption issue withdrawn with evidence 2026-09-05
area: Withdrawn: pre-close does disclose every prerequisite at once
finding: This item claimed that taskflow pre-close reveals close prerequisites one class at a time, costing a round trip per class. That claim is false and the item is withdrawn. The first pre-close run on ATM-GOV-0360 returned four blockers, and the fourth was staleEvidence carrying the exact list ['validate:cli','validate:git-head-evidence']. Every prerequisite was disclosed on the first call. The appearance of batched disclosure was created entirely by the consumer: the command output was piped through a reader that truncated at 3000 characters, so the last two blockers were never read.
expectedBehavior: Behaviour as built is already correct. buildHistoricalClosePreflight computes computeMissingValidatorReport unconditionally on every run and appends the stale-evidence blocker alongside the operational ones, so the blocker list is complete regardless of which other classes are currently present.
evidenceOrRepro: Re-read of the first pre-close response captured at HEAD f8f7789a3 shows blockers = [unexpectedStagedTasks ATM_INDEX_FOREIGN_ACTIVE_STAGED, scopeTrackedDirtyFiles ATM_TASKFLOW_PRECLOSE_SCOPE_TRACKED_DIRTY, unexpectedStagedNonBundleFiles ATM_TASKFLOW_PRECLOSE_UNEXPECTED_STAGED_FILES, staleEvidence ATM_TASKFLOW_PRECLOSE_STALE_EVIDENCE] with staleEvidence = ['validate:cli','validate:git-head-evidence']. The same two entries appear identically in the second and third runs. Source confirms the design at packages/cli/src/commands/taskflow/historical-close-preflight.ts, where the stale blocker is built from missingReport on every invocation.
followUp: No product change. The real defect was in how the diagnostic was consumed, and it is worth stating because it is easy to repeat: truncating a governance response and then reasoning about what is missing produces a confident, wrong conclusion. Read the blocker list in full, or count it, before concluding anything about disclosure. Withdrawn from ATM-GOV-0364, whose ACC-3 was removed for the same reason.
